text:
Alex Chen: Hey all — first day question: I found a hosted API key in the vault for my team. Should I use that for our CI integration tests or use the sandbox key? I need to run streaming tests and worried about hitting quotas / 429s.
Priya Patel: welcome! :wave: For CI we try to use the sandbox key unless the tests validate production routing/latency. Sandbox has lower quotas but is safer for dev. If you need higher throughput for CI, request a hosted test quota.
Alex Chen: ok — how do I request the hosted test quota? is there a form or just ping someone?
Samir Rao: ping ops-support with the org/team name and approximate qps and burst. we usually grant a temporary hosted quota for nightly CI runs. include repo + pipeline id. Example: "team-redwood/core-integ, nightly-run, 10 qps burst 50".
Alex Chen: thanks. also — is there an internal tool for ephemeral keys? I don't want to stash hosted key in repo secrets.
Priya Patel: yes use the DevEx key-proxy for short-lived tokens. It mint tokens scoped to a role and ttl, and integrates with GitHub Actions. DevEx Bot can provision a token for you if you run the helper.
DevEx Bot: To create an ephemeral token run:
```
./devex auth mint --role=ci-integration --ttl=2h --repo=org/repo
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /tmp/devex_token)
```
This token will be auto-revoked after ttl. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/devex/ephemeral-keys
Alex Chen: perfect. last thing — streaming tests keep getting 429s in sandbox when parallelizing. Is that expected?
Samir Rao: sandbox rate limits are lower and shared across teams. For streaming, prefer to sequence or lower concurrency. If you need higher concurrent streams for CI, request the hosted test quota mentioned above.
Sasha Li: security note — never commit hosted tokens. Use secrets manager (AWS Secrets Manager / GitHub Actions secrets) and IP allowlist if you must reference a long-lived hosted key for integration. We can add the CI runner IPs to the hosted key allowlist after approval.
Alex Chen: got it. I'll request hosted test quota and try ephemeral tokens for now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: ping me if you need the ops ticket template, I can paste it in the thread.
Alex Chen: would appreciate that, thanks!
